T_ref.data_reference: reference temperature of the rate constants (37 C)

dT_Q10.data_reference: definition of Q10 (rate ratio per 10 K)

Q10.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; metabolic Q10 is typically 2-3; 2 chosen pending a source

V_c.data_reference: geometry: 20 um diameter disc cell, 20 um deep (the game's starting cell)

C_O2.data_reference: celayaalcala2021simulation; mean tissue PO2 47 mmHg x 1.27 uM/mmHg (fang2008oxygen)

C_glc.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; intracellular glucose of order 1 mM (below plasma ~5 mM)

C_lac.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; resting lactate of order 1 mM

C_CO2.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; dissolved CO2 at 40 mmHg x 0.03 mM/mmHg (textbook solubility)

ATP_init.data_reference: traut1994physiological; mean ATP in mammalian cells 3152 uM

A_tot.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; ATP + ADP with ATP/ADP about 9

K_O2.data_reference: celayaalcala2021simulation; P0 = 10.5 mmHg x 1.27 uM/mmHg, the library's tissue value

K_glc.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; hexokinase I affinity for glucose, order 0.03-0.1 mM

K_ADP.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; apparent ADP affinity of respiration in tissue, order 0.3 mM

V_gly.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; anaerobic capacity: 2 V_gly is about 40% of resting ATP demand

K_i_O2.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; Pasteur effect: glycolysis half-inhibited at K_O2

K_ATP.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; ATPase affinity for ATP, order 0.1-0.5 mM

n_ATP_ox.data_reference: hinkle2005p; about 30 ATP per glucose oxidised

n_ATP_gly.data_reference: stoichiometry of glycolysis: 2 ATP per glucose to 2 lactate

h_O2_ox.data_reference: gnaiger1990anaerobic; oxycaloric equivalent -470 kJ/mol O2 (glucose oxidation)

h_lac_gly.data_reference: gnaiger1990anaerobic; glucose to lactate in bicarbonate buffer -63 kJ/mol lactate

h_ATP.data_reference: gajewski1986thermodynamics; Delta H of ATP hydrolysis -20.5 kJ/mol at 25 C
